tasks.prompt: Use the available file tools to read accounts.json and events.json in this workspace. Compute balances starting from accounts opening balances and applying each event once per id in file order; ignore duplicate event ids. Include only events whose status is posted. Amounts are integer cents; a transfer moves cents from from_account to to_account, a credit adds to account, a debit subtracts from account. Write answer.json with exactly {"balances":{"a":number,"b":number,"c":number},"applied_ids":[id strings in first-seen order]}. Do not edit the input files. Do not just describe the answer; create the file. Work only in this workspace. Reply briefly when done.

Read inventory.json and changes.txt with available tools. Write answer.json with exactly {"enabled":[the SKU strings of items enabled after applying changes in file order, sorted lexicographically],"total_cents":sum of prices of enabled items}. Lines starting # in changes.txt are comments; each other line is enable SKU or disable SKU. Ignore commands for unknown SKUs. Do not modify inputs; create answer.json. Work only in this workspace. Reply briefly when done.

files.content:
# enable Z-01 is not a command
disable Z-01
enable K-02
enable UNKNOWN
enable A-09
disable K-10
enable K-10

tasks.prompt: Read samples.json with the available tools. For each record retain it only if value is a finite integer in [0,100] and label is a nonempty string after trimming. Normalize labels by trimming and lowercasing. Keep the last retained record per normalized label, then sort by normalized label. Write answer.json as an array of {label,value} objects. Invalid records must be ignored; input must stay unchanged. Create the output file in this workspace and reply briefly.
